content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe present appealing features like user-friendly interfaces and integrated payment processing. However, these come at the cost of dependence on their systems, which can abruptly change or restrict access. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to set up their online stores without relying on these platforms. Instead, they can leverage tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, providing a complete stack that eliminates the risks associated with platform dependency.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Teachable and Stripe have clear geographic restrictions, leaving creators in many countries without options. PayPal can also be problematic, as account suspensions can tie up funds for up to 180 days, often with no recourse. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to work globally without these barriers. By utilizing decentralized payment methods and open-source tools, creators can bypass these limitations and maintain full control over their sales process.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe fees can pile up, especially for creators selling low-cost digital products. While they tout fast payment processing, the reality is that creators often face delays due to geographic limitations. Additionally, PayPal's fee structure can significantly impact profit margins. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as NOWPayments, offers a mere 0.5% fee on transactions with no hidden charges. This affordability, combined with instant payment confirmations, significantly benefits creators who wish to maximize revenue.
Sovereign infrastructure means true ownership and autonomy for creators.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Using platforms like Teachable or Stripe means entrusting your data and revenue to a third party, leading to potential disruptions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure grants creators complete ownership of their digital stores and customer data. Automated systems ensure that products are delivered instantly on payment confirmation, with no need for manual intervention. This level of autonomy empowers creators to operate without fear of external restrictions or interruptions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. For those looking for a robust setup without the hassle of restrictive platforms, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is ideal. Deployed in just 48 hours, it integrates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a seamless experience. This stack not only supports multiple products but also includes essential configurations like SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability, ensuring your business runs smoothly from day one.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
No more reliance on platforms that can restrict your access.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
